title: Peachtree Puttery — South Forsyth Entertainment Center
size: Approximately 31,800 SF two-story entertainment building; broader approved site also includes about 16,000 SF retail and a planned 110-room hotel
timing: The project broke ground August 10, 2026 at the Peachtree Parkway/Sentinel Chase Way site. The entertainment building includes bowling, arcade, dining/bar, axe-throwing and outdoor mini-golf components. With construction active, local subs should identify the current GC and confirm remaining MEP, low-voltage, fire-protection, kitchen/bar, specialty-equipment, finish and site packages; the associated retail/hotel phases provide follow-on pipeline.
source: North Atlanta Star / What Now Atlanta / Forsyth development reporting
